description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to the Block module API, including documentation, hook definitions for altering block behavior, access control, and plugin definitions.

methods.name: hook_block_view_alter
methods.description: Alters the rendered output of a block after it has been built, e.g., removing contextual links.

methods.name: hook_block_view_BASE_BLOCK_ID_alter
methods.description: Provides plugin-specific alteration of the block view, such as changing the title.

methods.name: hook_block_build_alter
methods.description: Alters the block's build array early, e.g., adding cache contexts.

methods.name: hook_block_build_BASE_BLOCK_ID_alter
methods.description: Provides plugin-specific early alteration, such as enabling placeholdering.

methods.name: hook_block_access
methods.description: Controls access to a block instance based on custom logic.

methods.name: hook_block_alter
methods.description: Allows modules to alter block plugin definitions.
